text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(What should I do. No matter how you look 
at it... did I gain weight!?)

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the help, Kita-chan. Here, take 
some of our manju with you if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the help, young lady. I don't 
know if it makes up for it, but here, have 
some rice crackers.

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Kita-chan! Come here, come here, 
I'll give you candy~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy about everyone's support 
that I accepted everything they gave me, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I need to swear off sweets for a while... 
I appreciate everyone's kindness, but I'll 
have to take just the thought...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—with a heavy heart, Kitasan 
Black turned down the treats everyone 
offered and successfully managed her diet.
